Rule.Name: RxdkXboxDeployment
Rule.Description: How media is collected and packaged for the console.

StringListProperty.Name: RxdkDeployPaths
StringListProperty.Description: Project-relative files or directories staged next to default.xbe (into the ISO and copied to the console on deploy), e.g. media or media\test.xmv.

StringListProperty.Name: RxdkEmbed
StringListProperty.Description: Files baked into the XBE at build time (imagebld /INSERTFILE). One 'source|section' per entry, e.g. media\dsstdfx.bin|dsstdfx (the section name defaults to the path when omitted).

BoolProperty.Name: RxdkCreateIso
BoolProperty.Description: Pack the build output into an .iso with xdvdfs. Set to No to stop at the .xbe (plus staged deploy files).
